verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation of an online exercise workflow appears in the pack. A community user reports exercising about $20k of options through Carta, with payment by bank transfer, which implies an online exercise-and-payment flow exists. However, that same report describes the transfer being attempted six months late, failing, and the exercise rights being permanently canceled. The FMV API only calculates tax implications of exercising, not the exercise itself. Missing for 10: first-party docs of the employee exercise flow, evidence of the resulting share issuance or certificate, reliable and timely payment processing, and independent corroboration of a paperless end-to-end process.
